column1: # scry trust-escape ledger (FEAT-105, #207). What the proofs rest on that the
#   gen  rows are regenerated in CI by `tools/proof-audit ledger` from the Rocq
#        sources (Section Variable/Hypothesis premises) and from the kernel
#        `Print Assumptions` audit (axioms); the file must match in both
#   hand rows record what no tool derives. Kinds: hand-mirror (a Rocq model
#        written by hand to mirror Rust; nothing checks the two agree),
#        gamma-swept (a transfer function whose soundness is only falsified by
#        an exhaustive concrete sweep, with its sweep geometry),
#        verus-assumption, verus-fork-pin. Every proof file needs a hand-mirror
#        row until it is extracted from the Rust (rocq-of-rust is enabled in
#        MODULE.bazel but no proof uses it).
